name: HASHIM MUSA RELEASE CONCERT @ HAVEN
description:
Hashim Musa is a multi-talented artist with Palestinian roots who's been creating waves for years, working across music, photography, and visual arts. This week, he's dropping his brand-new single "Loyal", and is ready to light up the stage this Friday at Haven, with special support from John Vincent.

Sigurdsgade 39, 2200
20 - 22
Concert starts at 21
Free entrance

name: HALLOWEEN PARTY: HAUNTED WAREHOUSE
description:
KLUB WERKSTATT,  REFFEN & CPH DRAG PRESENTS:
HAUNTED WAREHOUSE PARTY
 
This Halloween, Reffen & Klub Werkstatt invite you to the most terrifyingly fun night of the year. Get ready to step into our Haunted Warehouse where the thrills are real, and the scares are endless.

Get your ticket right here: https://billetto.dk/en/e/haunted-warehouse-party-billetter-1098678


Dresscode: Come dressed in your most terrifying outfit, or arrive to leave us spellbound. The most haunting and dreadful looks will be celebrated tonight!

Please be mindful and respectful, even the night creatures demand courtesy.


HORROR-DRAGSHOW: BOO, BITCH! The drag-queens from CPH DRAG are back and fiercer than ever—prepare for a show that will leave you screaming for more. The drag-queens are Di Di Cancerella, Denise Delight and Sascha Holiday.

TATTOO POP-UP: Take the fright night vibes with you forever (or at least until your next ink session)
500 DKK/Tattoo from flash sheet.

DEATH ALLEY: Venture into our bloody bar with (un)pleasant surprises lurking around every corner.
